7.1.2 Transceiver configuration
[SWS_WEth_10007]
Upstream requirements: SRS_V2X_00451
⌈The Wireless Ethernet Driver shall provide an API that enables the Wireless Ethernet
Transceiver to set the general radio specific parameters via an API WEth_WriteTrcv
Regs to the transceiver.⌋
[SWS_WEth_10008]
Upstream requirements: SRS_V2X_00451
⌈The Wireless Ethernet Driver shall provide an API that enables the Wireless Ethernet
Transceiver to get the general radio specific parameters via an API WEth_ReadTrcv
Regs from the transceiver.⌋
